description: This file defines the PHP class 'SubscriptionPlan' within the 'Opencartratalogrmodelrcatalog' namespace. It contains methods for retrieving subscription plan data from the database, including fetching a single plan, multiple plans with filters and sorting, and total count. The class extends the system's engine model, indicating it interacts with the database and application configuration.

classes.name: SubscriptionPlan
classes.description: Represents the subscription plan model with methods to retrieve individual plans, list of plans, and total count from the database.

methods.name: getSubscriptionPlan
methods.description: Fetches a single subscription plan by its ID, returning an associative array of details.

methods.name: getSubscriptionPlans
methods.description: Retrieves a list of subscription plans with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalSubscriptionPlans
methods.description: Returns the total number of subscription plans available in the database.
